setup.title: Your Tempest
setup.body: This replaces the city forecast with the station in your yard. The station ID is in the Tempest app, under that station's settings. Create a token at tempestwx.com under Settings, then Data Authorizations. The token is stored in a file only your user can read.
form.tokenSaved: Token saved. Enter a new one to replace it.
form.stationInvalid: The station ID is the number from the Tempest app.
form.tokenInvalid: That doesn't look like a WeatherFlow access token.
error.stale: Couldn't refresh. Showing the last reading.
error.notFound: WeatherFlow has no station with that ID.
error.token: Add a WeatherFlow personal access token.
error.unavailable: The station's weather couldn't be read.
